_doc: Recipients recovered from the official scans where a split webmail address left only its domain ("mail.com") in the header metadata. Written by scripts/reocr_fragments.py. engines = the OCR passes that read this address on the matching header line: either Tesseract and RapidOCR together, or two of Tesseract/RapidOCR/OnnxTR with none reading another address. The address is already a graph node and all candidate lines of the document agree. record = email_metadata.db emails_merged id; identity = pseudonymous address read; build_communications adds it as a recipient of that message.
_public_repo: Withheld in the public repository: reviewed records about individuals (personal data). Format: see _doc.
